real_defects.issue: Tallies keyed by fork-controlled text used plain objects: a PR branch named __proto__ wrote Object.prototype[<sha>] during the Portfolio Pages build and dropped __proto__/constructor branches from ci_pr (3 branches read as 1); a workflow named __proto__ or constructor made ciActivity throw (minutes.push on undefined), blanking the CI section. Fixed with null-prototype dicts for every such tally (byBranch, per-branch sha maps, byEvent, byWorkflow, redSince, failingWorkflows, reviewStates, run-record groups and friction); test 'hostile branch and workflow names' fails on main and passes after.
